say:1:1422313001:1.text: Freda, we've brought you a surprise! Look! Harge is back!
say:1:1422313001:1.source_cn: 弗瑞达，我们来啦！我们给你带来了惊喜。看！哈尔格回来啦！

say:2:1422313002:1.source_cn: 弗瑞达看上去一副意料之中的样子呢。

say:3:1422313003:1.text: Well, when Harge didn't reply to my letters, I guessed that he might be on his way home. After all, he would always write and tell me his new address every time he changed cities.
say:3:1422313003:1.source_cn: 其实，从哈尔格没有回信开始，我就猜到他或许在回家的路上...

say:4:1422313004:1.text: And then, out of nowhere, kind strangers showed up at my door to help me and Tali. It was almost as if someone had sent them...
say:4:1422313004:1.source_cn: 再加上突然有好心的陌生人帮助我和塔莉，像是受人所托的样子……

say:5:1422313005:1.text: What? Was Chippy's acting not enough? Did we look suspicious to you?
say:5:1422313005:1.source_cn: 唔……！满满演得不像好心的魔法使魔吗！我们难道看起来很...

say:7:1422313006:1.text: No, Chippy, you're the best! You've brought my father home!
say:7:1422313006:1.source_cn: 满满是好心的魔法使魔！你还帮我带回了爸爸！

say:9:1422313007:1.text: Tali, you're so big now! Freda... I...
say:9:1422313007:1.source_cn: 塔莉，你长高了！弗瑞达……我……

say:11:1422313008:1.text: Harge, all that matters is that you're back with us...
say:11:1422313008:1.source_cn: 哈尔格，不管怎样，你回来就好……

say:12:1422313009:1.text: Harge has been preparing to come home for a while. He even brought a gift!
say:12:1422313009:1.source_cn: 哈尔格为回家准备了很久，他还给你们带了礼物呢！

say:13:1422313010:1.text: I made this lute myself... Tali, I know you can't play yet, but I will teach you.
say:13:1422313010:1.source_cn: 是我亲手做的鲁特琴……塔莉，爸爸知道你还不会弹奏它，以...

say:15:1422313011:1.text: Wow! It's so beautiful! Look at all the flowers! I will definitely do my best to learn!
say:15:1422313011:1.source_cn: 好漂亮的礼物，被鲜花装饰着呢！塔莉会好好学怎么弹琴的！

say:16:1422313012:1.text: Alright, everyone, don't just stand there. It's time to eat, sing, and dance! Let's show these guests what a real dwarven party looks like!
say:16:1422313012:1.source_cn: 好啦朋友们，别傻站着啦，我们来唱歌，跳舞，享用美食！让...

say:17:1422313013:1.text: Ah, my mage friend, come play a song for us!
say:17:1422313013:1.source_cn: 魔法师朋友，来为我们弹奏一曲吧！
say:17:1422313013:1.male: Ah, my mage friend, come play a song for us!
say:17:1422313013:1.female: Ah, my mage friend, come play a song for us!
